principle_violations.reason: The Shape interface requires implementation of both area and volume methods. This forces Square and Circle classes to provide a volume method that they don't logically need.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the Shape interface into two interfaces: an AreaInterface and a VolumeInterface to segregate these responsibilities. Shapes that do not have volume should not implement the volume interface.

principle_violations.reason: The SumCalculator class duplicates the logic for outputting the sum calculation in different formats.
principle_violations.suggestion: Extract the common logic for obtaining the sum into a separate method to avoid code duplication.

principle_violations.reason: The SumCalculator class is responsible for both calculating the summary and formatting it, violating single responsibility.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibility of formatting the output into a different class, such as OutputFormatter.
